title: AIH Type-1 — demographics, ANA, HLA and histological hallmarks
guide: F>>M 2nd–3rd decade; ANA 100% (also drug-induced erythematosus, MCTD); HLA-DR03 → SLE/lupoid hepatitis, HLA-DR04 → RA, T1DM, autoimmune thyroid; lymphoplasmacytic inflammation; interface hepatitis (piecemeal necrosis), emporipolesis (engulfing without killing), rosette formation; acinus legend and limiting plate.

title: Presentation arms, laboratory markers and antibody tables
guide: Acute (waxing/waning jaundice, non-resolving; rule out HAV/HBV/HEV → Wilson's, autoimmune ANA+, FHF rare); chronic (fatigue + hepatomegaly with RA/SLE; LFT <150 ALT>AST → fibroscan; rare/slow progression); cirrhosis (portal HTN, liver failure, HCC also in hemochromatosis); A/G reversal → polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia; Type-I ANA 100%, SMA, AAA poor prognosis, SLA most specific/poor, atypical p-ANCA (AIH/PSC/UC); Type-II LKM-1 (HCV), liver cytosol-1 poor; LKM-2 drug, LKM-3 HDV; AMA = PBC, cholestasis triad not in AIH.

title: Type-II AIH and treatment algorithm
guide: Children, poor prognosis, HLA DR-7, T1DM/vitiligo/APS-1; fibroscan for cirrhosis; steroid 1 mg/kg/day × 4 weeks, taper 12 weeks, ± azathioprine; after 3–4 months remission (symptomatic, histological, ↓ bilirubin, enzymes normal) vs relapse → transplant → recurrence risk.
